acquisition method: The Orbitrap Elite (Thermo Fisher Scientific) was operated in the data-dependent mode using Xcalibur v3.0
alkylation reagent: then alkylated with 15 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 30 min in the dark at room temperature.
alkylation concentration: then alkylated with 15 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 30 min in the dark at room temperature.
cleavage agent: Proteins were digested with sequencing grade modified trypsin (Promega, V5111) with a ratio of 1:50 w/w (trypsin:protein) at 37°C water bath for 16 hours.
collision energy: HCD parameters were set to an isolation width of 1.6 m/z, normalized collision energy of 40%, and an activation time of 0.1 milliseconds.
enrichment method: Ribonucleoprotein (RNP) affinity purification through streptavidin (SA)-binding 4xS1m aptamers was employed
fragmentation method: to acquire higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD) MS/MS scans
instrument: coupled online to an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: Each sample was labeled with a distinct TMT label (TMTsixplex, Thermo Scientific, 90066) following the manufacturer’s manual
ptm: deamidation (NQ) dynamic; oxidation (M) dynamic; TMT6plex (N-term and K) static; carbamidomethyl (C) static
with deamidation (NQ) and oxidation (M) dynamic modifications, and TMT6plex (N-term and K) and carbamidomethyl (C) static modifications.
reduction reagent: proteins in RNase A elutions after 4xS1m pulldown were denatured with 5 mM DTT and 2 M urea for 1 hour at 65°C
reduction concentration: proteins in RNase A elutions after 4xS1m pulldown were denatured with 5 mM DTT and 2 M urea for 1 hour at 65°C
